The plate is a square plate, about 26 cm across in the image (roughly 345 px wide, so about 0.075 cm per px).

Each corn piece is about 100 px across, which is roughly 7.5 cm. That matches a corn cob cut into rounds with a diameter of about 3.5-4 cm. The width in the image of about 100 px would be about 7 cm if the plate is 26 cm, which seems large for a corn cob. The plate may be smaller, around 22 cm, which gives about 6 cm per piece. These are probably thick cob rounds about 2-3 cm long, and the cob itself is included.

Each piece is a cylinder with a 6 cm diameter and a 3 cm height, so its volume is about 85 cm³. The cob core takes up some of that, so I estimate about 70 g per piece, or 140 g for two. Corn on the cob is about 90 kcal per 100 g.
